card.name: Where patient counts and study statistics come next
card.fires_on: The word patients, of, or a sentence-ending period in label text that is about to give numbers or percentages from clinical studies, such as "Of the total number of patients" or "in patients treated with [drug]."

modes.label: Patient totals in studies
modes.description: The word patients or of inside a phrase counting study participants, as in the geriatric use section.

modes.label: Period after treated-with statements
modes.description: A period ending a sentence on adverse events in patients treated with a drug, just before study results are given.
modes.example: Severe diarrhea occurred in 1% of patients treated with TAVALISSE<<.>> Monitor patients for the development of diarrhea.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about statistics and surveys, such as statistics, statistical and survey.
card.plain: It marks spots where the label is about to give study numbers, like how many patients had an effect.
